request.subject: UNIT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Replace the boat with a small old-fashioned wooden submarine lying low at the very bottom of the image, exactly where the boat's hull is now: a closed fat cigar-shaped hull of pale straw-yellow birch planks with light steel bands and two round glass portholes; on top a short round bright red conning tower with a thin steel periscope and a small red pennant; a red tail fin. No mast, no sail. The upper half of the image stays empty. Keep the thick black outline and style.
